name: Kit - Default (seed v1)
description: A kit: a loadout of equipment and inventory items that players claim with /kit, staff give, or new players receive on first join, with optional access rules, cooldown and price.

steps.description: Name the kit. To copy a loadout, wear and hold it in game, fill your inventory, and use Send to Minecraft on the name: the scan fills the Equipment and Contents steps and asks before overwriting.

fields.label: Name
fields.description: Players claim the kit with /kit get <name> (any case), so keep it short and unique. The scan button on this field never changes the name.

fields.label: Description
fields.description: Optional; a short line about what the kit is for.

steps.description: What the player wears and holds. Every slot is optional. If the player already has something in a slot, the kit's item goes to the first free inventory slot (or is dropped at their feet).

fields.label: Off-hand
fields.description: Placed in the off-hand; usually a shield, but any item works.

fields.label: Main hand
fields.description: Placed in the hotbar slot the player has selected when the kit is granted.

steps.description: Items placed in fixed inventory slots, one entry per slot. A kit scan fills this list; add or edit entries with Create New Join Entry.

fields.label: Inventory slots
fields.description: Each entry is an item, a slot (0-35) and a quantity.

steps.description: Who may claim the kit, and whether new players get it automatically. The three requirements are optional and must all be met.

fields.label: Minimum title
fields.description: Players below this title (by experience) can't claim the kit. Empty = any title.

fields.label: Permission group
fields.description: Only active members of this group can claim it, e.g. a premium tier such as Noble for a tier-only kit. Membership of another group doesn't count.

fields.label: Permission node
fields.description: Players need this permission (directly or through a group). Empty = no permission needed.

fields.label: Give on first join
fields.description: Every new player gets this kit once on their first join, free and without cooldown; the requirements above still apply.

steps.description: How often the kit can be claimed and what it costs. A premium kit is bought once with Gems; after that it is free and has no cooldown.

fields.label: Cooldown (seconds)
fields.description: Time a player must wait after claiming before claiming again, e.g. 86400 = once a day. 0 = no cooldown.

fields.label: Price per claim
fields.description: Taken from the player's balance on every claim (0 or more; at most 999,999,999 Coins or 999,999 Gems). Empty or 0 = free.

fields.label: Price currency
fields.description: Coins (earned in game) or Gems (premium). Needed for the price to apply: a price without a currency charges nothing.

fields.label: Premium kit (buy once)
fields.description: Players must buy the kit once with Gems before they can claim it; after that, claims are free and have no cooldown.

fields.label: Premium price (Gems)
fields.description: One-time price in Gems, 1-999,999. A premium kit without a price can't be bought.
